pages.text: Activated Crystals can be turned into shards in two ways.$(br2)$(thing)Hydrogen chloride$(): 1 Activated Crystal makes 1 shard. This is the easy path.

$(thing)Rhenium$(): 8 Activated Crystals make 16 shards, so 2 shards per crystal.$(br2)Counting the activation step, 5 crystals give 8 shards with HCl, or 16 with Rhenium. That is $(thing)3.2x$() the normal amount.
